name: Novus DayNight
description:
Automatically switches GTK themes, color scheme, wallpapers, Night Light, and display brightness based on local sunrise/sunset times or a custom schedule.

Optional location auto-detection uses GeoClue2 with fallback to ipinfo.io and nominatim.openstreetmap.org.

Based on Automatic Theme Switcher by Amritashan S. Lal.
